files.name: ShoreCarve.java

help: After shore times out in water: swim to the nearest visible dry spot, digging a step through walls that block the climb
lesson: Shore times out in the same water again and again after underground drowning, so the follow-up should pick a nearby dry spot it can see and dig through the wall that blocks it, not only swim harder toward remembered land.
summary: shore_carve: after shore TIMEOUT/STUCK in water, swims by keys to the nearest visible dry stand spot and digs through the wall when it stops closing, so the bot gets out of pits it can't climb.
